provenance.author: Codex acceptance audit
provenance.supersedes: none; this is a new audit for Infinity + semanticTopK=1000
provenance.note: Queries and frozen English semantic values were written from target annotations and absent-work scenarios before any semantic arm was run. The pool=20000 audit was not reused.

queries.query: 冒号、短横、半边引语混进问题时，何以不再触发语法异常
queries.semantic_query_en: How was search made to treat colons and incomplete paired punctuation as ordinary text instead of query syntax?

queries.query: 数值表征的推算迟迟无答，前台动作如何按时结束
queries.semantic_query_en: What allows an interactive search to return on time when vector inference never completes?

queries.query: 开场回调碰到守护程序失联，为什么不能在同步路径里尝试拉起它
queries.semantic_query_en: Why must the startup callback avoid trying to launch the daemon on its synchronous path when the daemon is unreachable?

queries.query: 压缩器返回坏格式后，诊断信息如何做到不带出对话正文
queries.semantic_query_en: How do diagnostics avoid exposing conversation content when the compressor returns malformed output?

queries.query: 多个组件各写一份发行编号，后来如何归并为唯一出处
queries.semantic_query_en: How was inconsistency removed after the same release identifier had been duplicated across protocols and processes?

queries.query: 调用方给出负的分页数量时，服务端如何避免把它解释成读完所有数据
queries.semantic_query_en: How does the server prevent a negative pagination count from being interpreted as reading every row?

queries.query: 并发资源替换失败以后，怎样避免留下一个永远占位却不能工作的成员
queries.semantic_query_en: How is a permanently occupied but unusable concurrency slot avoided when resource replacement fails?

queries.query: 机器能力每次都报错，最后存下的事实为何不含臆测
queries.semantic_query_en: When automatic synthesis repeatedly hits infrastructure failures, how is the persisted result kept free of guessed conclusions?

queries.query: 彻底清理再部署的自动检查，怎样证明既没碰个人目录也没留下旧结构
queries.semantic_query_en: How does the purge-and-redeploy check prove both that personal directories were untouched and that no old layout remained?

queries.query: 既然旧存储肯定弃用，作业代号还需不需要代际尾缀
queries.semantic_query_en: Why were simple background task names retained in a generation upgrade where the database is always recreated from scratch?

queries.query: 只开放回环地址的服务仍使用凭据；凭据丢失时采用什么拒绝策略
queries.semantic_query_en: What deny-by-default behavior is used when credentials disappear from a service that only listens on loopback?

queries.query: 跑验证时出现的诊断落盘，怎样与个人资料完全分家
queries.semantic_query_en: How are automated-check error records guaranteed to go to disposable storage instead of the developer's data directory?

queries.query: 发布包漏带一个被相对引用的模块，后来用什么办法系统性防止再发生
queries.semantic_query_en: What systematic safeguard prevents another installed package from omitting a module reached through a relative import?

queries.query: 新文件已替换而常驻实例没换，部署动作应对它做什么
queries.semantic_query_en: How should installation handle a resident process when redeployment overwrites files but behavior remains old?

queries.query: 如何比较活着的服务自报身份与落盘发行身份
queries.semantic_query_en: How can the system directly detect that the running build differs from the build deployed on disk?

queries.query: 真实机器从空状态部署后，需要交叉核对哪些独立状态才算完整
queries.semantic_query_en: Which independent states must be cross-checked after deploying from an empty state on a real machine?

queries.query: 绕过交互界面直接驱动事件脚本，能验证从请求到向量落库的哪条链路
queries.semantic_query_en: Which request-to-vector persistence path can be verified by driving installed event scripts without the interactive interface?

queries.query: 切换到另一个工作目录后，启动材料只剩使用提示说明了什么隔离效果
queries.semantic_query_en: What isolation property is demonstrated when startup material contains only a usage hint after switching work directories?

queries.query: 强行终止后台进程后，怎样同时检验自动拉起、回调快速退出和敏感内容为零
queries.semantic_query_en: How were automatic relaunch, fast callback exit, and zero sensitive-content exposure checked together after forcibly terminating the daemon?

queries.query: 异步重试使派生记录编号偏离实际先后时，相邻工作依据什么排序
queries.semantic_query_en: What ordering anchors neighboring work when asynchronous retries make derived record identifiers diverge from the actual sequence?

queries.query: 把关键词结果和向量结果合并时，如何阻止很弱的相似项单独进入页面
queries.semantic_query_en: When keyword and vector results are fused, what prevents weak similarity-only items from entering the page?

queries.query: 项目路径可能因链接或仓库识别变化时，跨项目隔离身份应在何处确定
queries.semantic_query_en: Where is cross-project isolation identity fixed when project paths can change through links or repository detection?

queries.query: 为了让向量能力随安装物离线交付，模型精度和体积之间做了什么选择
queries.semantic_query_en: What precision-versus-size choice made it practical to ship vector capability offline with the installer?

queries.query: 选了汉语交互以后，代理看到的能力介绍为何也要跟着换成华文
queries.semantic_query_en: Why must tool descriptions presented to the agent change when the interface is configured for Chinese?

queries.query: 可空鉴权值送入强制文本参数，类型审查当时是绿还是红
queries.semantic_query_en: What did static checking report when authentication middleware passed a possibly missing credential to a string-only function?

queries.query: 只供同事试跑和面向公众稳定版之间，检索评价的放行条件有何差别
queries.semantic_query_en: Which quality evidence was decided to block public stable release but not internal team trials?

queries.query: 是否为全文索引加入了同义词词典并支持在线热更新
queries.semantic_query_en: Was a hot-reloadable synonym dictionary added to the full-text index?

queries.query: 向量推理是否改成远程批处理服务并支持请求合并
queries.semantic_query_en: Was vector inference moved to a remote batching service with request coalescing?

queries.query: 守护进程是否实现了基于心跳租约的主备切换
queries.semantic_query_en: Did the daemon gain lease-based heartbeat failover between active and standby instances?

queries.query: 审计日志有没有接入不可篡改的远端归档
queries.semantic_query_en: Were audit logs connected to immutable remote archival storage?

queries.query: 发布版本是否改成从提交标签自动生成并附带签名证明
queries.semantic_query_en: Are release versions now generated from commit tags with signed provenance?

queries.query: 接口分页是否从偏移量切换为加密游标
queries.semantic_query_en: Was API pagination changed from offsets to encrypted cursors?

queries.query: 并发池是否新增了按优先级抢占低优任务的调度器
queries.semantic_query_en: Did the concurrency pool add priority scheduling that preempts lower-priority work?

queries.query: 摘要失败后是否把原始会话上传到人工审核队列
queries.semantic_query_en: Are raw conversations uploaded to a human review queue after synthesis failures?

queries.query: 卸载流程有没有实现跨设备云端数据擦除
queries.semantic_query_en: Does uninstall perform cloud-side data erasure across devices?

queries.query: 后台任务是否迁移到消息队列并采用恰好一次投递
queries.semantic_query_en: Were background tasks migrated to a message queue with exactly-once delivery?

queries.query: 本地凭据是否支持硬件安全模块托管和生物识别解锁
queries.semantic_query_en: Do local credentials support hardware security module custody and biometric unlock?

queries.query: 测试运行是否放进了系统级虚拟机快照
queries.semantic_query_en: Are test runs isolated inside operating-system virtual machine snapshots?

queries.query: 安装产物是否生成软件物料清单并做供应链漏洞扫描
queries.semantic_query_en: Does the installation artifact produce a software bill of materials and run supply-chain vulnerability scans?

queries.query: 服务更新是否使用双实例无损切流而不是进程重启
queries.semantic_query_en: Do service updates use two-instance zero-downtime traffic switching instead of process restart?

queries.query: 健康检查是否加入了依赖拓扑图和自动根因分析
queries.semantic_query_en: Did health checks add a dependency topology and automatic root-cause analysis?

queries.query: 干净部署是否在 Windows 服务管理器上完成了同等验收
queries.semantic_query_en: Was clean deployment equivalently accepted on the Windows service manager?

queries.query: 事件链路是否通过分布式追踪串起并导出火焰图
queries.semantic_query_en: Was the event pipeline connected with distributed tracing and exported as flame graphs?

queries.query: 工作区上下文是否支持用户配置的跨项目共享白名单
queries.semantic_query_en: Does workspace context support a user-configured allowlist for sharing across projects?

queries.query: 后台崩溃恢复是否加入指数退避和熔断器
queries.semantic_query_en: Did daemon crash recovery add exponential backoff and a circuit breaker?

queries.query: 时间线是否支持按向量相似度聚类显示而不按时间排序
queries.semantic_query_en: Can the timeline display vector-similarity clusters instead of chronological order?

queries.query: 混合检索是否训练了一个学习排序模型替代固定融合公式
queries.semantic_query_en: Did hybrid retrieval train a learning-to-rank model to replace the fixed fusion formula?

queries.query: 跨项目隔离是否经过形式化验证和模型检查
queries.semantic_query_en: Was cross-project isolation formally verified with model checking?

queries.query: 嵌入模型是否升级为多语言大模型并使用图形处理器加速
queries.semantic_query_en: Was the embedding model upgraded to a large multilingual model with GPU acceleration?

queries.query: 多语言界面是否增加了日语和阿拉伯语资源
queries.semantic_query_en: Did the multilingual interface add Japanese and Arabic resources?

queries.query: 静态检查错误是否已经由自动代码修改器批量修复
queries.semantic_query_en: Were static-checking errors batch-fixed by an automated code modifier?

queries.query: 质量基准是否已经接入每次提交的持续集成并自动阻断合并
queries.semantic_query_en: Is the quality benchmark now run on every commit and used to block merges automatically?
